lines.text: If the people obey the LORD, He will set them high above all the nations of the earth.
The people will be blessed in the city and the country, and their basket and kneading bowl will be blessed.
Enemies who march out against Israel in one direction will flee from them in twelve.
If they keep His commandments and walk in His ways, the LORD will establish them as His holy people.
The LORD will open the heavens to send manna on their land in season.
